title: Docker Compose (seed subset)
description: A small but representative subset of the docker-compose.yml schema used to seed Ayiru with config_field_exists claims. Valid Draft-07 JSON Schema; the same Stage 7c.2 ingestion lane that runs against the live schemastore.org doc accepts this verbatim.

version.description: Compose file format version (deprecated in v2+ but still recognised).

services.description: Map of service name to service definition. The primary section of any Compose file.

networks.description: Networks declared at the project level.

volumes.description: Named volumes declared at the project level.

secrets.description: Secrets declared at the project level.

configs.description: Externally-managed configuration files mounted into services.

name.description: Project name override. Useful when running multiple compose projects on the same host.

x-extension.description: Compose supports user-defined fields prefixed with `x-` for extensions.
